evidence.cost_assumption: not a standalone after-cost long-only factor; top-bucket net/excess diagnostics negative
evidence.falsification: High-score long baskets were negative despite positive residual/partial IC; V18 is not an official standalone factor and should only be considered as a capped low-weight model-stack feature.
evidence.portfolio_policy: partial-IC residual tests and rolling 60-date linear ablation; top bucket diagnostics used as falsification
evidence.universe: full and middle_20_90 primary; smallest_20 showed little incremental value

mechanism.complexity_penalty_reasoning: Further nonlinear gates were rejected because OOS bucket shape already falsified standalone high-score trading; added complexity would likely optimize a weak residual feature instead of creating a robust long-side payoff theorem.
mechanism.dirac_style_forced_insight: The occupation-measure object forced the research to separate two claims: a state can contain weak conditional drift information, while its high-score tail can still be an untradeable mixture of crowded repair, stale support, and hidden liquidation.
mechanism.economic_hypothesis: The value-occupation repair state is a short-horizon inventory and liquidity imbalance proxy. Recent traded value below the reference price and lower price-axis support may indicate absorbed selling pressure, but the payer is unstable: stale holders, repair chasers, inventory rebalancers, or hidden liquidators can all appear in the high-score tail.
mechanism.factor_expression: v18_repair_drift_score over intraday_value_occupation_state_v1 plus daily risk/path controls
mechanism.information_preserved_removed: The linear V18 score preserves below-cost depth, lower support mass, short drift, and volatility penalty, but it compresses barrier/target geometry into one scalar and removes the full payoff shape of the price-axis mass distribution.
mechanism.payer: fragile short-horizon inventory/liquidity imbalance: repair chasers, stale holders, forced sellers, and inventory rebalancers
mechanism.random_object: latent inventory state proxied by intraday price-axis occupation measure and daily return process
mechanism.receiver: a diversified model stack that can use weak residual drift while capping extreme high-score tail exposure
mechanism.target_statistic: OOS residual/partial IC and rolling model delta IC, not standalone top-bucket long return

relations.note: V18 is built from the price-axis occupation state rather than raw time-domain returns.
The occupation state proxies latent inventory and liquidity imbalance.
This closeout adds OOS residual and bucket-payoff evidence to the earlier support-overhang mechanism.
Both preserve weak ranking information but fail as standalone high-score long strategies.
Positive partial IC coexisted with negative high-score bucket returns.
Use as a low-weight linear model feature with exposure caps, not as a standalone optimizer score.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node for value-domain, occupation-measure, support/overhang, or Lebesgue-measure factor ideas.
Always test both residual/partial IC and bucket payoff shape; do not use positive IC alone for long-side admission.
Prefer simple linear usage with exposure caps; stop formula engineering if high-score tail remains negative.
Use middle_20_90 as a more relevant test universe than smallest-cap buckets for this mechanism.
summary: Value-occupation V18 is a durable lesson for value-domain factors: price-axis occupation states can carry weak residual short-horizon ranking information, but positive partial IC does not imply a tradable top-score long basket.
title: Value occupation V18 weak residual drift and failed long tail
